concerns.text: SC‑001 specifies a pass/fail success criterion (≥ 80 % of 1,000 bootstrap resamples must meet d ≥ 0.3 and p < 0.05), but the only related task (T006) merely reports the bootstrap proportion without enforcing the threshold. No task validates that the criterion is satisfied, leaving the success condition uncovered.

SC‑002 requires a measurable consistency check for p‑values across regions and thresholds, yet the implemented task (T007) only computes a coefficient‑of‑variation (CV) and does not define a pass/fail threshold or verify that the CV meets any stipulated bound. Consequently the success criterion for SC‑002 is not covered by any task.
